status: SECONDARY (not promoted to primary unless explicitly sealed as primary before any outcome)

predeclared.matching_rule: each random ROI has EXACTLY the Wang25 voxel count on the target grid
predeclared.gm_constraint: random voxels drawn only from cortical gray matter (TemplateFlow 2009c res-02 GM>0.5)
predeclared.wang_exclusion: random voxels EXCLUDE the Wang25 union (disjoint)
predeclared.participant_statistic: E_subject = R_I_Wang25 - mean_k(R_I_random_k), same frozen imagery estimator, imagery-session unit
predeclared.cohort_inference: one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test across subjects of E_subject>0, alpha=0.05, sealed BEFORE any outcome; H0: median E<=0 (Wang25 R_I not enriched vs size-matched random cortex)
predeclared.type_I_target: <=0.05 under the strict null (Wang25 == random in expectation)
